title: •_Stinger_
caption: •_Stinger_ (V)
game_text: May add 1 pilot. Guri deploys -3 aboard. While Guri piloting, during any control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck (if Leia or Chewie on table, Force Pile instead) and immune to attrition < 5.
lore: Constructed by a secretive Surronian hive craftguild. Equipped with H2-1 hyperdrive system and emergency braking jets. Guri’s personal starship. Gift from Prince Xizor.

notes: Unique. _Stinger_ italic in the slip's heading and caption (the printed title is italic too). Banner STARFIGHTER: SURRONIAN CONQUEROR. Stats POWER 3 / MANEUVER 4 / HYPERSPEED 5; deploy 2 / forfeit 4 — the stub's 'deploy=4' is the forfeit (stub error). Scomp ring → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: blue nav computer → nav; red square with an R2 droid dome → astromech (matches Game Aid g013 / the astromech icon on vs3/16, vs4/15) — odd for a ship, but that is what the slip prints (printed card had pilot/nav/independent). Two-line margin credits: left 'Original concept / by Michael Bahr', right 'PC Volunteer / Award 2006'. Lore corrected: curly apostrophe in Guri’s (wiki straight). Base scan 354 px; copyright '© 2000 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.' read off the 745 px V0 remake (same top half). Modern: V0-D-stinger.gif (745 px); VB4 -pre (354) also exists, not downloaded.
